title: ARMY Membership Presale Opens for Asia & Australia Legs of ARIRANG World Tour
detail: June 2, 2026: Big Hit Music opens the ARMY MEMBERSHIP presale for the Asia and Australia legs of BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' via Weverse. The presale covers newly announced dates in Kaohsiung (Taiwan) — with a 12pm local-time presale window — and Australia (Melbourne and Sydney). The Australia presale runs from 1pm AEST on June 2 through 9am on June 4, with a maximum of 4 tickets per show; ARMY MEMBERSHIP (GLOBAL) registration was required by May 27. General on-sale for both territories is set for June 4, 2026. The Asia and Australia leg (November 2026–March 2027) forms the final chapter of the ARIRANG World Tour, which spans 82 dates across 34 cities in 23 countries and is projected to gross approximately $1.8 billion — comparable to Taylor Swift's Eras Tour. With European dates opening June 26 in Madrid, the June 2 presale completes the global ticket sale rollout for the tour. ARMY participation in Weverse presale queues for Sydney and Melbourne is reported to be the highest-ever for an Asia Pacific BTS tour announcement.

media.caption: BTS WORLD TOUR ARIRANG — Asia & Australia leg ARMY presale opens June 2, 2026, covering Kaohsiung, Melbourne, and Sydney dates

title: 'SWIM' Ties 'Dynamite' for BTS's Longest No. 1 Run on Billboard Global (Excl. US) — 8th Consecutive Week
detail: Billboard publishes its June 6, 2026 chart issue on June 2, confirming that 'SWIM' has now spent 8 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Global (Excl. US) chart — tying 'Dynamite' (2020) for BTS's longest-ever No. 1 run on that chart. The tracking week of May 22–28 tallied 41.8 million streams (down 8%) and 2,000 sales (up 8%) outside the United States. The milestone marks a historic level of sustained dominance: no K-pop track had previously held the Global (Excl. US) No. 1 for this long, and the tie now puts SWIM in contention to surpass 'Dynamite' and set an outright record if it holds for a 9th week. SWIM is now in its 11th consecutive week on the Billboard Hot 100 (No. 55), itself an all-time K-pop record for sustained chart longevity on that chart. ARIRANG's full catalogue remains active on global streaming charts heading into BTS FESTA 2026 (the 13th anniversary countdown), with the Busan Asiad Main Stadium concerts on June 12–13.

media.caption: 'SWIM' ties 'Dynamite' for BTS's longest No. 1 run on Billboard Global (Excl. US) with 8 consecutive weeks — June 6 chart issue

title: BTS Confirmed for 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival in Las Vegas — September 18–19
detail: The 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival lineup is announced on June 2, 2026, confirming BTS as headliners at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas on September 18–19, 2026. The lineup also features Cardi B, Zara Larsson, and Benson Boone. BTS's iHeartRadio booking represents their second Las Vegas stage appearance in 2026 — following the Allegiant Stadium ARIRANG residency (May 23–28, ~260,000 fans) — and forms part of the wider post-North American tour period before the European leg (opening Madrid, June 26) and the Asia and Australia legs (November 2026 onwards). The iHeartRadio Music Festival has been a significant milestone for BTS's US career: the group previously used US media appearances to build mainstream recognition. The September booking suggests HYBE is maintaining US visibility for BTS through the second half of 2026 even as the world tour moves to other continents.

media.caption: BTS confirmed as headliners at 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival at T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas, September 18–19
